steps.en: Install the library into a Python environment
steps.zh: 把库装进 Python 环境
steps.code: pip install fonttools · pip install fonttools[ufo,lxml,woff,unicode]

steps.en: Open a font file as an object model
steps.zh: 把字体文件打开成一个对象模型
steps.code: from fontTools import ttLib · tt = ttLib.TTFont("afont.ttf")

steps.en: Parses each binary sfnt table into typed attributes you can read and write
steps.zh: 把二进制的 sfnt 表解析成可读写的类型化属性

steps.en: Read or edit any table in place
steps.zh: 就地读取或修改任意一张表

steps.en: Recompiles your edits into a valid binary font when you save
steps.zh: 保存时把改动重新编译成合法的二进制字体

steps.en: Cut webfonts down to exactly the glyphs you ship
steps.zh: 把 webfont 裁到只发布需要的字形

value.en: Read, edit, subset and convert font files without parsing sfnt binaries by hand
value.zh: 不手撕 sfnt 二进制，就能读改、子集化、转换字体文件
